newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 29.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 29.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Croatia's privatisation fund has turned down Hungarian oil company MOL's bid for a 12.5 percent stake in the Adriatic oil pipeline.
- The water level of Fekete Koros (Crisul Negru), a river crossing the border with Romania in southeastern Hungary, is peaking just now.
- The tax authority APEH found irregularities in the operation of half of the retail and catering units investigated in the region of Lake Balaton.
- Hungary will increase the number of its soldiers participating in the UN's peacekeeping mission in Cyprus.
